title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Benefits: Courtesy Card Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards adds a card supplement to a courtesy credit for late fulfilment when the member's active physical Pocketwire Visa Debit Card is on one of the top card tiers.

## Rule

The courtesy card supplement is 1000 points when the member's active physical debit card is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card, 500 points when it is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card, and nothing when it is any other card or there is none. The supplement is added to the courtesy credit for the late redemption, in whole points.

The record read is the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card whose status is active and whose form is physical, and the card tier it carries.

## Supplement by card tier

| Active physical card | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 1000 points |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 500 points |
| any other tier, or no active physical card | nothing |

## Point of judgement

A member whose only Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card has been closed and replaced by an active physical Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit card receives nothing: the active physical card decides.
